engine.notes: The Comedy Spot has been the city's improv school and stage for years; STAB! on Broadway is the alternative room with a free Sunday jam, and Haus of Comedy is the newest school, performing in Old Sacramento. Punch Line and Laughs Unlimited are stand-up clubs.

entries.name: Sacramento Comedy Spot
entries.area: Midtown (20th St theater; T St training center)
entries.summary: Sacramento's first comedy theater, a 501(c)(3) with a Midtown stage and a separate training center that calls itself Northern California's largest comedy school; improv, stand-up and sketch shows most nights of the week.
entries.schedule: Shows five to six nights a week; Improv Taste Test select Saturdays 6pm ($15); monthly Improv Jam (next Nov 15, 2026)
signals: Improv 101, 201 (Scene Work) and 301 (The Helix) class ladder
Free Diversity Improv Space first Sundays
Monthly Improv Jam pairs students with veteran cast
Runs Femme Fest and the Weird Strange Bizarre festival
Two locations: 1050 20th St and 915 T St
entries.reasons: Two dedicated buildings, a three-level ladder with drop-ins and a student jam, shows nearly every night and a calendar dated into 2027; it just does not publish class dates on the page.

entries.name: STAB! Comedy Theater
entries.summary: Sacramento's alternative comedy room on Broadway: improv fundamentals and short-form classes, stand-up, a free Sunday improv jam and house formats such as Improvivor, PowerPlay and the short-form Sacramento Improv Theater show.
entries.schedule: STAB! Jam every Sunday 7pm, free; shows listed on the calendar
signals: Classes in Improv Fundamentals, Improv Short Form and Stand Up
Free Sunday jam, names drawn from a bucket, at least two turns up
House improv shows: Improvivor, PowerPlay, The Arena, Whose Shorts Are These Anyway?
Livestreams shows on Twitch and YouTube
entries.reasons: Its own venue, a weekly free jam and several house improv formats, but the class pages carry no dates or prices and the calendar text does not surface on the site.

entries.name: Haus of Comedy
entries.area: Shows at the Eagle Theatre, Old Sacramento
entries.summary: Jessilee Windhaus's improv company, founded in 2023 and independent since August 2024, teaching Improv 101-401 with drop-ins and master classes and producing short-form shows at the Eagle Theatre in Old Sacramento.
signals: Founded 2023 under Empire Arts Collective, independent since Aug 2024
Core series Improv 101-401 in six-week and intensive formats
Diversity scholarships for the core series
House group Sharks Barksley; Improv Team Jam for local teams
Shows at the Eagle Theatre, Old Sacramento
entries.reasons: A proper four-level curriculum with drop-ins and scholarships and regular shows, but it is three years old, rents its stages and lists dates only through its ticketing pages.
